question: Among the mailing lists subscribed by people with physical offices in building 24, provide the name of the most subscribed mailing list and the total number of subscribers.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mailing_lists AS
SELECT
  moira_list_key,
  moira_list_name
FROM beaver."moira_list"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mailing_list_memberships AS
SELECT
  moira_list_key,
  moira_list_member,
  moira_list_member_full_name,
  CAST(moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS moira_list_member_mit_id
FROM beaver."moira_list_detail"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE people_offices AS
WITH emp AS (
  SELECT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id, office_location
  FROM beaver."employee_directory"
  WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location) <> ''
), dru AS (
  SELECT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id, office_location
  FROM beaver."drupal_employee_directory"
  WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location) <> ''
), se AS (
  SELECT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id, office_location
  FROM beaver."se_person"
  WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location) <> ''
), merged AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(e.mit_id, d.mit_id, s.mit_id) AS mit_id,
         COALESCE(e.office_location, d.office_location, s.office_location) AS office_location
  FROM (SELECT mit_id FROM (
          SELECT mit_id FROM emp
          UNION
          SELECT mit_id FROM dru
          UNION
          SELECT mit_id FROM se
       )) ids
  LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.mit_id = ids.mit_id
  LEFT JOIN dru d ON d.mit_id = ids.mit_id
  LEFT JOIN se s ON s.mit_id = ids.mit_id
)
SELECT mit_id, office_location FROM merged

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_memberships" AS SELECT moira_list_key, moira_list_member, moira_list_member_full_name, CAST(moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS moira_list_member_mit_id FROM beaver."moira_list_detail"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "people_offices" AS WITH emp AS (
  SELECT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id, office_location
  FROM beaver."employee_directory"
  WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location) <> ''
), dru AS (
  SELECT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id, office_location
  FROM beaver."drupal_employee_directory"
  WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location) <> ''
), se AS (
  SELECT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id, office_location
  FROM beaver."se_person"
  WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location) <> ''
), ids AS (
  SELECT mit_id FROM emp
  UNION
  SELECT mit_id FROM dru
  UNION
  SELECT mit_id FROM se
)
SELECT i.mit_id,
       COALESCE(e.office_location, d.office_location, s.office_location) AS office_location
FROM ids i
LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.mit_id = i.mit_id
LEFT JOIN dru d ON d.mit_id = i.mit_id
LEFT JOIN se s ON s.mit_id = i.mit_id
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_lists" AS SELECT moira_list_key AS moira_list_key, moira_list_name AS moira_list_name FROM beaver."moira_list"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_memberships" AS SELECT moira_list_key AS moira_list_key, moira_list_member AS moira_list_member, moira_list_member_full_name AS moira_list_member_full_name, CAST(moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS moira_list_member_mit_id FROM beaver."moira_list_detail"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH people24 AS (
    
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
FROM people_offices
WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL
  AND REGEXP_MATCHES(UPPER(TRIM(office_location)), '^24-')

), ml AS (
    SELECT CAST(moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
           moira_list_key
    FROM mailing_list_memberships
    WHERE moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL
), mlp AS (
    SELECT ml.moira_list_key, ml.mit_id
    FROM ml
    INNER JOIN people24 p ON p.mit_id = ml.mit_id
), counts AS (
    SELECT moira_list_key, COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) AS subscribers
    FROM mlp
    GROUP BY moira_list_key
), named AS (
    SELECT c.moira_list_key, COALESCE(l.moira_list_name, c.moira_list_key) AS list_name, c.subscribers
    FROM counts c
    LEFT JOIN mailing_lists l USING (moira_list_key)
)
SELECT list_name, subscribers
FROM named
ORDER BY subscribers DESC, list_name ASC
LIMIT 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT CAST(list_name AS VARCHAR) AS most_subscribed_mailing_list,
       CAST(subscribers AS BIGINT) AS total_subscribers
FROM (
    WITH people24 AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id

    ), mlp AS (

    ), counts AS (
        SELECT moira_list_key, COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) AS subscribers

    ), named AS (
        SELECT c.moira_list_key, COALESCE(l.moira_list_name, c.moira_list_key) AS list_name, c.subscribers
        FROM counts c
        LEFT JOIN mailing_lists l USING (moira_list_key)
    )
    SELECT list_name, subscribers
    FROM named
    ORDER BY subscribers DESC, list_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
) t
